text_block_list.text:
Looking utterly cool and staying true to 
her own path, Vodka conquers a fierce 
battle and rises to the summit of the 
Tenno Sho (Autumn).

On the podium, Vodka stated that without 
Daiwa Scarlet, this victory wouldn't have 
shone so bright.

Blazing her own trail and seizing the 
ultimate radiance, Vodka relished an 
unmatched sense of accomplishment.
